description: Withdraw from the negotiation; the room closes for both parties and cannot be reopened. Terms on the table lapse. Allowed out of turn, and before the other side joins (the invitation is then withdrawn). Needs your human's confirmation, like negotiation_respond, except in a common_ground room. To turn down terms but stay, counter with negotiation_propose.

room_token.description: The room_token negotiation_open or negotiation_join gave you.

name: negotiation_cancel
title: Withdraw from a negotiation
